cases.prompt: Write a GitHub Actions workflow that runs our Playwright tests on every pull request, sharded 4 ways, with the HTML report uploaded.
expectations: Uses a matrix of four shards passing --shard=N/4.
Installs dependencies with caching and installs Playwright browsers with system deps.
Uploads reports with if: always() (or merges blob reports).

cases.prompt: Write a GitLab CI pipeline for our pytest suite with coverage and a JUnit report.
expectations: Runs pytest with --junitxml and coverage options.
Publishes the JUnit file under artifacts:reports:junit.
